description: Bullish/bearish classification of each symbol's unusual flow with a 0-9 strength score, based on call/put volumes, premium and net delta. Pass a symbol for that ticker's sentiment time series (date_from, date_to, limit apply); omit it for the cross-market snapshot (filterable by sector, side, minimum strength or premium).

date.description: Trading day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the latest available day.

min_premium.description: Minimum call+put premium in USD (snapshot only).

min_strength.description: Snapshot only; rows without a signal count as 0.

offset.description: Snapshot only. Rows to skip for paging; the response reports filtered_total and has_more.

sector.description: GICS sector name, e.g. 'Information Technology' (snapshot only).

side.description: Only rows classified with this signal side (snapshot only).

signal_only.description: Only rows with an active bullish/bearish signal (snapshot only).

symbol.description: Single ticker for its sentiment series; omit for the market-wide snapshot.

name: get_flow_sentiment
title: Flow sentiment (Pro)
